description: Carga de Energia Mensal is a dataset listed in Brazilian national electricity system operator open data portal (ONS), an open data portal, published or maintained by ONS. Dados de carga por subsistema em base mensal, medida em MWmed. Até dezembro/2014, os dados representam a carga atendida por usinas despachadas e/ou programadas pelo ONS, com base em dados recebidos pelo Sistema de Supervisão e Controle do ONS. Coverage: Brasil. The portal files it under the publisher ONS. Its tags are Carga, Histórico da Operação, Mensal. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, PARQUET, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Atribuição. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ons-portal.
